actual_scope: Six P104 construction methods, each stated with its scope and a small exact standard-library demonstration: (1) the exact {0}/V re-basis test of helper mixing, demonstrated by rebuilding the helper-761 rung merge of #7542 from #7334's word; (2) absorption (a helper settled against a register's outstanding junk), its clean-iff condition and the last-outstanding-cell rule, with the sigma-anchor deficiency result as frame-free algebra on A3/A4 toys; (3) range-G y pre-loads, Y_t = x_t with J_t = (11/2)G_t on all 104 columns; (4) signed-row helpers with a Rado transversal test and LU realisation into elementary ADDs; (5) the O+(8,2) quotient structure of the 104 ports (sign law, 12-port blocks, c-sum triples); (6) the t = -1 MONOHUB joint caller and the four 20-odd-op floor callers, with the form-orbit and even-fusion checks.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a constructive helper-basis or causal-split improvement. This package documents the methods behind our P104 work (#7542, #7555, #7557) so others can reuse them; it makes no kappa claim and ships no new word.
bottleneck_link: Each method is a tool for the complete P104 bill: re-basis removes paid helper rungs (the #7542 gain), absorption and pre-loads re-price the U- and L-side junk layers, the Rado/LU rule prices helper fan-out exactly, the quotient model organises the port geometry, and the callers fix the t = -1 caller side of the invoice.
stop_rule: Every stated number reproduced by a standard-library checker from repository data or vendored, hash-authenticated data, with biting controls; validator PASS.
evidence: README.md, PROOF.md, rebasis.py, absorption.py, preload.py, rado_lu.py, quotient.py, callers.py, VERIFY.json.
